name: Collateral 55
definition: Provides details on the collateral that will be either delivered, returned or both.

MarginCallRequestIdentification.name: Margin Call Request Identification
MarginCallRequestIdentification.definition: Specifies the reference to the unambiguous identification of the margin call request.

MarginCallResponseIdentification.name: Margin Call Response Identification
MarginCallResponseIdentification.definition: Specifies the reference to the unambiguous identification of the margin call response.

CollateralProposalResponseIdentification.name: Collateral Proposal Response Identification
CollateralProposalResponseIdentification.definition: Specifies the reference to the unambiguous identification of the collateral proposal response (in case of counter proposal).

OtherCollateral.name: Other Collateral
OtherCollateral.definition: Collateral type is other than securities or cash for example letter of credit.
